theorems.name: Submission.ind_pi_span_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ h : Eucl P → ℝ, ∫ z in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Eucl P)), h z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ a : Eucl n, h (∑ i, a i • τ i)) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Eucl P))) K < ∞
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
